comment: Small molecules (sorafenib, GTP, GDP, EGF) are classified as chemical. RAS family species are represented as complexes when nucleotide-bound (Ras_GTP, Ras_GDP) and expanded to the three common RAS paralogs (HRAS, KRAS, NRAS) per the instruction to expand families. Phosphorylated species (pRaf1, pMEK, pERK, nfp* etc.) are treated as the corresponding protein (RAF1, MAP2K1/2, MAPK3/1, SOS, BRAF) with the modification dropped in the standardized name. Inhibited forms (iRaf1, iBRaf, iBRaf_dimer, BRaf_iBRaf_dimer, nfpi* entries where inhibitor is present) are represented as complexes containing the kinase protein plus sorafenib. EGFR and ligand complexes list EGFR (ERBB1) and EGF; receptor–adapter complexes list GRB2 and SOS expanded to SOS1/2. All multimeric/tetrameric species are reported by listing their protein (and chemical) components rather than modified labels.
